sentences.en: A guest came to Juha’s house.

sentences.ar: הוא היה בן דוד רחוק מאוד.
sentences.en: He was a very distant cousin.
He brought him food and a bed.
After two days the guest stayed.

sentences.ar: אחרי שבוע הוא עוד היה שם.
sentences.en: After a week he was still there.
She said: say something to him.
Juha did not want to hurt him.
In the morning he sat with him to eat.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: יש לי שאלה קטנה.
sentences.en: He said: I have a small question.

sentences.ar: הוא שאל: דג טרי כמה ימים טוב?
sentences.en: He asked: a fresh fish is good for how many days?
The guest said: two days, maybe three.

sentences.ar: האורח אמר: אחרי זה יש ריח.
sentences.en: The guest said: after that there is a smell.
Juha said: and a guest is the same.
The guest took his bag and went.
